videos.title: [🔴속보] 삼성전자 메모리 1인당 6억원 수령…적자 사업부도 최소 1억 6천만원 성과급 / 연합뉴스TV(YonhapnewsTV)
videos.subtitle_summary:

videos.title: 삼성전자 파업 피했지만...주주 반발 '불씨' 여전 / YTN
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. Samsung Electronics avoided the strike-related production issues, but variables still remain, particularly the controversy over performance bonuses that have upset shareholders who claim it harms their interests.
2. The shareholder group has threatened legal action, and they gathered near Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong's residence to protest against the proposed performance bonus agreement, claiming it is illegal without shareholder approval.
3. The shareholder movement and Samsung Electronics shareholders have announced their intention to immediately intervene at a national level, declaring that they will initiate the four major legal procedures simultaneously if the illegal resolution, illegal contract, and illegal business continue in reality. They also plan to file a lawsuit for the annulment of any invalid decisions made by the board and to demand compensation for any illegal actions.

videos.title: [삼전 파업 통합본 2] "우리도 성과급 줘" 폭발한 중국인들, 삼성 귀족 노조 파업의 최후

videos.title: HD현대重, 테라파워·현대건설과 4세대 원전 ‘맞손’
videos.subtitle_summary: HD Hyundai Heavy Industries and TerraPower-a subsidiary of South Korea's Hyundai Engineering & Construction, have signed a business agreement for the commercial deployment of fourth-generation nuclear power, Natrium. Natrium is a safer and less wasteful alternative to traditional nuclear power, which TerraPower is currently pursuing in Wyoming, USA. This collaboration aims to strengthen HD Hyundai Heavy Industries' supply chain by providing nuclear reactor components, while Hyundai Engineering & Construction will leverage its expertise for potential future commercial participation. HD Hyundai Heavy Industries plans to accelerate global power demand and market penetration of the nuclear industry by combining their manufacturing capabilities with Hyundai Engineering & Construction's construction expertise.
